question: Open a discover unit that adds the hosted Parallel MCP server at https://mcp.parallel.ai/mcp as its own record: slug parallel-keyless, a tier other than 'Pay as you go', identity anonymous, verdict qualifies-with-caveat, with the standalone endpoints search.parallel.ai/mcp and task-mcp.parallel.ai/mcp named in interface_detail.
why: Answer to queue item 20261030-1045-expand-crawler-scraper-47c4-u03-q01: yes. web_search, web_fetch and web_decisions need no account, key or card (https://docs.parallel.ai/integrations/mcp/quickstart, https://docs.parallel.ai/integrations/mcp/programmatic-use, the FAQ on https://parallel.ai/mcp); the vendor changelog announced keyless access on 2026-04-23 (https://docs.parallel.ai/resources/changelog); the vendor states it does not publish the anonymous rate limit and that without an account there is a limit on how much can be searched; anonymous web_search runs in fast mode, excerpts are capped near 25,000 characters a call, and override settings need a key. A GET to /mcp answers 405 with allow POST, DELETE, OPTIONS, while /mcp?login answers 401 and says it needs an API key (two probe records, 2026-11-01). Identity (anonymous against a card), allowance (unpublished against USD 5 a month) and limit differ from crawler-scraper/parallel, as tavily-keyless and firecrawl-keyless differ from their keyed records. crawler-scraper/parallel carried no tier, and the integrator folds a draft into a record when one side names none, so this run proposes the tier 'Pay as you go' on it; a draft with another tier is then added as a new record.
